data: Reuse v0.1 composition partitions: train=576, development=192, evaluation=192. New reader fitting sees train text/meaning pairs and initial lexicon only. This is NOT a newly collected or project-unseen evaluation corpus.
supervision: Only text and 5-slot meaning per pair. No order labels, state sequence, action sequence, token-role annotations or original reader outputs. Lexical ID equality derives alignments automatically; ambiguous training alignments are rejected.
prior_knowledge: Content token kinds and lexical IDs; surface inventory with semantically unlabelled markers; fixed 5-slot schema; ordered abstract-shape feature family; finite candidate values; maximum tokens and association counts.
scope: Same 6 names, 4 verbs, 2 constructions and 4 polarity/modality combinations as v0.1. Abstract whole-shape matching is learned, so unseen syntax is not claimed.
generator: Byte-preserved v0.1 results/model (evaluation-0), fixed for all reader seeds. No generator fitting or legacy reader use in the new pipeline. Old reader invoked only for an explicitly separate reference score.
counterfactual_note: Role/state label flips are artificial controls, not correct Japanese meanings. Marker renaming tests opaque-symbol learning. All are scored against their explicitly transformed meaning labels.
reference_note: Ordinary lookup uses the same pair-derived features and supervision. Fixed v0.1 uses prior trace supervision. Report both; do not claim equal byte footprint, speed/energy advantage or independent corpora.

stress.note: End-to-end low-dimension probe, not a new adaptive confidence method; errors/false accepts must remain visible.

scoring: Independent bounded grammar implementation in preserved v0.1 oracle, not the new reader's own readback. Abstentions count as misses over all requested output goals. No independent human annotation.
